detail.longDescription: Public talk by Alessandra Buonanno On 2 November, Alessandra Buonanno, director at @ mpi_grav in Potsdam, will give a public talk at the event “Einstein Telescope: Europas Blick in die Zukunft” as part of Berlin Science Week. ℹ️ https:// berlinscienceweek.com/programm e/einstein-telescope-europas-blick-die-zukunft 📅 2 November, 2026, 18:00-21:00 CET 🚩 Futurium, Alexanderufer 2, 10117 Berlin, Germany # EinsteinTelescope # Research # Europe # GravitationalWaves # physics # astrophysics # Berlin # BerlinScienceWeek
